description: This file implements the Controller class for marketing functionalities in the OpenCart admin panel. It manages marketing campaigns including listing, creation, editing, deletion, reports, and autocomplete features.

classes.name: Marketing
classes.description: Controller for managing marketing campaigns in the admin interface, handling CRUD operations, listing, reporting, and autocomplete functionalities.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Displays the main marketing page with filtering options and list of marketing campaigns.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and renders a paginated list of marketing campaigns based on filters.

methods.name: form
methods.description: Displays the form for creating or editing a marketing campaign.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Handles saving of a marketing campaign, either creating or updating.

methods.name: report
methods.description: Displays the report related to a specific marketing campaign.

methods.name: getReport
methods.description: Retrieves data for a marketing campaign report with pagination.

methods.name: autocomplete
methods.description: Provides autocomplete suggestions for marketing campaigns based on filter input.
